command: Implement the approved descriptor/ISA v2 contract in schema, Python typed packers, Command128 root-role validation, segment compiler and examples. Generate frozen expected-vector JSON entrypoints. Run all contract/spec/example tests with taskset -c 8-25 after confirming MemAvailable >10 GiB, then commit and push the isolated contract checkpoint before modifying production sequencer RTL.
success_condition: Schema v2 fields do not overlap; every new record round-trips and rejects illegal enums/reserved bits; unused roots are NULL_INDEX; every opcode enforces the frozen root roles; all existing and migrated Python/spec/segment regressions pass.
failure_policy: Stop at the first contract mismatch. Do not weaken root roles, use zero for absent roots, assign ad-hoc subtype/common-flag meanings, change 128-bit command layout, or modify production sequencer RTL before the contract checkpoint passes.
